name: asc-marketing-manager
description: API-aware workflows for dry-running and syncing localized App Store Connect metadata, screenshots, and pricing audits.

interface.shortDescription: Dry-run and sync App Store metadata, screenshots, and pricing audits with API-aware safety.
interface.longDescription: ASC Marketing Manager gives Codex focused knowledge of the App Store Connect API for localized text metadata, screenshot assets, and read-only pricing audits. It turns Google Sheets or desired-state JSON into a validated dry run, can create a missing editable app version when requested, applies only explicitly reviewed changes for names, subtitles, descriptions, keywords, URLs, What's New, promotional text, App Review fields, and localized screenshot sets, and can audit regional paid-app pricing schedules without applying price changes.
defaultPrompt: Compare my localization sheet with App Store Connect before release.
Create a dry run for version 2.3 using my App Store copy sheet.
Dry-run replacing my localized screenshot sets from this asset folder.
Audit my current regional App Store pricing schedule.
